headline: Colorado Nonprofit Accepts 31-Acre Campus Donation, Begins $3.2 Million in Sustainable Energy Improvements
summary: Aurora, Colorado, April  24, 2019  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AURORA – The real-estate based nonprofit Urban Land Conservancy (ULC) recently announced the launch of a $3,200,000 sustainable energy capital improvement project at their Oxford Vista property located at 15001 E. Oxford Avenue. Previously the Excelsior Youth Center, Oxford Vista is a 31-acre campus in Southeast Aurora serving as the AmeriCorps NCCC Southwest regional headquarters.
